finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** Out of 380 commits, 3 breaking, 1 added, 9 fixed.

The 3 breaking ones are buried under `refactor:` prefixes. Dropped v1 export route. Error types no longer re-exported from 5 modules. Expired tokens now return 401, not 403.

All 16 dep bumps are patch or minor. None reach a user.

Two things to check before you cut:

1. Confirm the release date. I wrote `2026-08-28` but commits stop 2026-06-17.
2. Confirm whether `engines` really moved. 5 docs commits and CI now run node 22, but no `package.json` here to verify. I left it out.

I also left out 9 perf commits. Your template allows only the three headings.
